name: smwgraphics-freedom-planet-aqua-tunnel
title: Freedom Planet - Aqua Tunnel
description:
A pack of some of the backgrounds layers used in the level Aqua Tunnel, in Freedom Planet. Includes one Layer 2 BG + two Layer 3 BGs (there's an optional full 512x512 alternative to Layer 2's).
It's recomended to use a Sprite Status Bar patch for best usage of the Layer 3.
